va-county-board-members.area: Virginia — all 95 counties and 38 independent cities
va-county-board-members.summary: The County or City card names your county or independent city, and not the members of its board of supervisors or city council, nor which member represents the spot you picked.
va-county-board-members.why: This app has not yet read the state's election results, which name every member, or drawn the districts most of them are elected from.
va-county-board-members.wanted: Nothing from a reader — the state publishes both, and building them is ours to do.

va-magisterial-district-lines.area: Virginia — the counties whose current election districts differ from the Census Bureau's copy
va-magisterial-district-lines.summary: The Magisterial District card draws the Census Bureau's copy of each county's districts, which in many counties is older than the county's current lines.
va-magisterial-district-lines.why: The Census Bureau's map matches the state's current election districts closely in only about a third of the counties that elect by district.
va-magisterial-district-lines.wanted: Nothing from a reader — the state publishes the current lines, and drawing them here is ours to do.

va-municipal-officeholders.summary: The City or Town card names the place and says whether it is a city or a town, and not its mayor or council members.
va-municipal-officeholders.why: This app has not yet read the state's election results, which name the mayor and council of most cities and towns.
va-municipal-officeholders.wanted: Nothing from a reader — the state's election results name them, and reading them is ours to do.

va-school-board-members.summary: The School Division card names your division, and not the members of its school board, nor which member represents the spot you picked.
va-school-board-members.why: Most Virginia school boards are elected, and this app has not yet read the state's election results that name them or drawn the districts they are elected from.
va-school-board-members.wanted: Nothing from a reader — the state publishes both, and building them is ours to do.

va-voting-precincts.summary: This app does not draw Virginia's voting precincts yet, so it cannot tell you which precinct your spot is in.
va-voting-precincts.why: The state's Department of Elections publishes a map of every county's and city's precincts, and this app has not built it yet.
va-voting-precincts.wanted: Nothing from a reader — this one is ours to build.
